source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for tile_r in range(3):
        for r in range(h):
            src_r = h - 1 - r if tile_r != 1 else r
            row = []
            for tile_c in range(3):
                for c in range(w):
                    src_c = w - 1 - c if tile_c != 1 else c
                    row.append(grid[src_r][src_c])
            out.append(row)
    return out
'''
